memoryExecutionPolicy.causeQualification: The accepted original memory implementation is reused unchanged. This new eleven-row selector-target candidate tests format learning after the selector baseline failed; no quality result is claimed before execution.
memoryExecutionPolicy.checkpointing: Non-reentrant recomputation for deterministic frozen projection/loss; preserve stochastic decoder/LoRA RNG behavior. No target truncation, per-chunk reweighting or independent example splitting.
memoryExecutionPolicy.continuation: One fresh-base selector fit: original eleven accepted selector rows, fixed seed17 permutations, six epochs and exactly66 updates. Preserve complete targets/EOS and all cumulative resource/control/base/save histories. Stop on failure. Return the fit proof and saved adapter; no reload, inference, diagnostic or evaluation is authorized by this fit assignment.
memoryExecutionPolicy.equivalence: Retain the accepted 64-token head-loss and reclamation controls. One small contained attention fixture compares the original pinned full causal SDPA output and Q/K/V gradients with the 128-query implementation, including the offset second block and 7-query final block. Use the predeclared attentionControlBeforeFit tolerances; preserve/restore RNG and persistent state. Failure returns the control evidence before any fit; no relaxed tolerance or retry.
memoryExecutionPolicy.implementation: One decoder forward; select the same assistant-predicting hidden positions; frozen lm_head projection and float32 summed cross-entropy in 64-token checkpointed chunks; sum chunk losses and divide by exact total supervised tokens including EOS. Avoid storing full vocabulary logits/float copy/backward buffers.
memoryExecutionPolicy.instrumentation: Retain accepted finite-loss, before/after cache, per-example and cumulative native/GPU observations. Record the bound attention implementation/control hash, block count and maximum query block length for actual examples, with truthful executed-update/progress counts and original exceptions. No peak resets or acceptance of a transient cap breach.
memoryExecutionPolicy.interUpdateReclamation: After each completed scaler/optimizer update and scalar progress capture, set adapter gradients to None, release all finished-step tensor/graph references including the norm scalar, collect unreachable Python cycles, synchronize as necessary and empty only unused CUDA allocator cache before the next example. Apply the same unused-cache reclamation after model/base-digest setup before the first example. Keep the model, trainable parameters, Adam moments, scaler, encoded examples, epoch order and RNG states alive and unchanged. Never free live storage, reset peaks or recreate/move the optimizer/model between examples.
memoryExecutionPolicy.preBackwardReclamation: After the existing finite loss and cumulative bound observation and before scaler.scale(loss).backward(), synchronize and release only unused cache using the existing leaf release_unused_cache routine. Keep ids/labels/target/selected/hidden/loss and all saved autograd/checkpoint state live and connected; do not detach, zero gradients, run the decoder again, or delete graph references here. Preserve the existing post-setup and post-update reclamation.

queryChunkedAttention.causalMask: For block start s, allowed key k satisfies k <= s + localQueryIndex. Use explicit absolute-position boolean causal mask with is_causal=False for each rectangular SDPA call. Never use a fresh is_causal=True triangle per block, drop earlier context, split source examples or reweight loss.
queryChunkedAttention.gradients: Keep Q/K/V connected, include all query outputs, aggregate K/V and adapter gradients through autograd; no detach or manual approximate gradient. Persistent optimizer/scaler state and masks/denominators unchanged.
queryChunkedAttention.installation: Use a fit-scoped Qwen-local attention-interface override and restore it in finally; do not alter the global shared registry, third-party source bytes, baseline or reload/generation path.
queryChunkedAttention.primitive: Existing pinned torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention, math backend with unchanged float32 math intermediates for float16 inputs; no new attention algorithm, kernel dependency, precision option or parameter.
queryChunkedAttention.schedule: Compute original complete Q/K/V and RoPE through the original Qwen attention forward; process only the query axis in contiguous blocks, retaining all original K/V positions and grouped-query semantics. Non-reentrant RNG-preserving checkpoint each SDPA block, then concatenate in original query order and use the original output projection. Keep the existing decoder checkpointing and one logical decoder forward.
queryChunkedAttention.scope: Fit-only, exact loaded Qwen2 attention instances, batch1 equal full query/key lengths, 14 query heads/2 KV heads/head dimension64, no past cache or sliding window, zero attention dropout and no output_attentions. Fail unsupported masks/shapes/kwargs honestly instead of silently falling back. Preserve model configuration/weights and all q/v adapters/dropout/RNG.

attentionControlBeforeFit.qualification: Technical objective-preservation fixture only, never source truth or model quality.
attentionControlBeforeFit.reference: Original pinned Transformers SDPA causal route, same Q/K/V and scalar objective, no candidate-derived reference.
attentionControlBeforeFit.toleranceReason: Tight double-precision algebra check; CUDA permits fp16 GEMM/reduction and grouped K/V gradient-accumulation rounding with unchanged float32 math/loss. No bitwise equality claim for the full fit.
requirements: all Q/K/V gradients finite and within tolerances
all query outputs preserved in order
absolute causal offsets and final short block covered
no model parameter or optimizer/precision changes
